locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure, zero extension, and the source-limit normalization
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, retained inside m_lambda before positive and negative parts are formed
locked_conventions.quotient_metric: D'' is self-adjoint on E_N/C*xi in the T=Q-epsilon*I metric, not in an assumed Euclidean quotient metric
locked_conventions.determinant_normalization: nonzero scalar rescaling is allowed only when carried explicitly; it preserves the finite zero set but not an uncontrolled limiting amplitude
locked_conventions.source_normalization: 4*hat(k_lambda^+) tends to Xi; unit-normalizing h_lambda is rejected

locked_formulas.exact_projective_low_distance: for x=P_M*kappa, u=P_M*z_mu, y=x-u, inf_t ||P_M(t*w-kappa)||=||x||*||P_(x^perp)u||/||y|| when x,y are nonzero
locked_formulas.conditional_transverse_target: at M=ceil(lambda), Lambda_(M,perp)(U)=lambda^(-1/2+o(1)) and ||(A-U*I)^(-1)b||=lambda^o(1) suffice for the projective low/high transform hypotheses
locked_formulas.conditional_anchor_criterion: a_j^2*E_(U_j)*L_(z0)(U_j)->0 and a_j^2*E_(U_j)*L_(K,wedge)(U_j)->0 for every compact K, together with strict finite signs and the proved projection theorem, imply F_j->Xi locally uniformly in the open strip
locked_formulas.quotient_inverse: for onto W:X->K and B=A-U*I>0, W*(W^*B*W)^dagger*W^*=B^(-1)
locked_formulas.raw_transverse_support: L_M=(P_M*H_+) intersect (P_M*kappa)^perp is contained in K and S_M=P_(L_M)|K, so S_M^* is ordinary inclusion of a genuinely low-Fourier subspace
locked_formulas.far_schur_identity: with B=A-U*I>0, H_h=P_F(B+hI)|F, Sigma_h=D_h-Gamma^*H_h^(-1)Gamma, and f_h=b_Y-Gamma^*H_h^(-1)b_F, one has S_M(A-sI)^(-1)b=P_(L_M)Sigma_h^(-1)f_h for h=U-s>=0
locked_formulas.honest_far_feedback: at M=ceil(lambda), G=1, the explicit high-coercivity cutoff R=M_*(lambda,U,1) on the locked outer schedule makes d_(lambda;M,R)^2/G_R and d_(lambda;M,R)*K_(lambda,N)/G_R super-polynomially small
locked_formulas.middle_obstruction_model: B_epsilon=[[1,1,0],[1,1+epsilon,0],[0,0,G]], b_epsilon=[0,epsilon,0]^T has vanishing residual and Ritz lowering with perfect far decoupling, but Omega_0^(-1)eta_0=-1 and exact low projective distance 1/sqrt(2)
locked_formulas.forced_odd_equation: under the finite simple-even hypothesis, T=Q-epsilon*I, T_->0, T*D*xi=-beta, and D*xi=-T_-^(-1)*beta
locked_formulas.odd_response: g_alpha=sum_(n=1)^N sqrt(2)*n/(n^2+alpha^2)*e_n^-, A(alpha)=1+<g_alpha,T_-^(-1)beta>, and h(i*alpha)=i*A(alpha)/alpha with A(alpha)>0
locked_formulas.two_height_trace_gate: for fixed 0<tau<sigma<1/2, sup_j S_q(lambda_j,N_j;sigma)<infinity if and only if inf_j R_q(lambda_j,N_j;tau,sigma)>0
locked_formulas.odd_response_necessity: a uniform first trace forces A(gamma)/A(alpha) to be bounded above and below by positive constant multiples of (tau/sigma)*exp((sigma-tau)*L/2)
locked_formulas.subexponential_obstruction: if log(A(gamma)/A(alpha))=o(L), then S_q is bounded below by a positive fixed multiple of L+o(L)
